bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.follow.0: Not out here. Follow me, and keep your voice down.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.follow.1: Business? Not in the street. Walk with me.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.follow.2: Shh. The book's kept below. Come on, this way.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.this_way.1: Not here, I said. Just follow.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.down.1: Under the hatch. Shut it behind you.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.down.2: After me, quick, before anyone looks.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.hush.0: A book? I don't know what you're talking about.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.hush.1: Bets? Never heard of such a thing, friend.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.hush.2: Keep your voice down, there's a guard right there!
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.lying_low.0: Not now. The watch has ears everywhere.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.lying_low.1: With the guards like this? I'm only out for bread.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.street.lying_low.2: Leave it a day. Someone's been talking.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.greet.1: The book's open. What do you fancy?
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.greet.2: Wars and fists, I take money on both.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.how: Hold the coin you mean to stake (up to %s) and click a line.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.nothing: Nothing on the book right now: no war young enough to bet on, and no bout called. (Up to %s a bet when there is.)
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.hover: Stakes the coins in your hand
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.none: There's no bookie close enough to take your bet.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.hold: Hold the coins (or a coin purse) you mean to stake.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.fight: [Step into the ring yourself: %s to enter]
